name: Blockr
summary: A privacy-first website blocker for Chrome that keeps all its data on your device.
highlights: Built and published a privacy-first extension on the Chrome Web Store, keeping all data local with no backend.
Blocked sites via Manifest V3's declarativeNetRequest API, with schedules, daily time limits and a password lock.
Wrote Vitest suites covering blocking rules, schedules, usage tracking and storage migrations.
Designed the UI in Figma, with light and dark themes audited to ensure they meet WCAG AA contrast.

name: Zen
summary: A focus and productivity app for Android, designed in Figma first.
highlights: Designed the app in Figma from stakeholder feedback, then built it in Kotlin with a pomodoro timer, task reminders and streak stats, earning the Edinburgh Award (Digital Skills Specialist).
Set up GitHub Actions CI running lint, unit tests and Espresso UI tests on an emulator, with automated accessibility checks on every UI interaction.
